title: Sources
description: The upstream repos the principles and skills are distilled from, each pinned to a commit.

role.description: skill-source: real skill, agent and command files we may borrow from. curation-list: a pointer to other sources, never installed wholesale.

licence.description: SPDX identifier where GitHub reports one; otherwise a description naming the licence file, or "no licence file found". TBD only before the check

pin_source.description: How pinned_sha was obtained: review-record (the commit the repo was reviewed at, from data/licences.json or the Step 4 review) or github-head (default-branch HEAD at pinning time, for a repo with no review commit)

labels.description: Short names used for this repo in principle sources
